title: Account settings
subtitle: Manage your profile, security, notify preferences, and workspace identity.

profile.title: Profile
profile.subtitle: This information represents you throughout MoleSignal.
profile.email_hint: Your email is managed by an administrator or identity provider and cannot be changed here.
profile.bio_hint: Briefly describe your responsibilities or team, up to 500 characters.
profile.avatar_hint: PNG, JPEG, or WebP, up to 2 MB.
profile.avatar_too_large: The avatar must be no larger than 2 MB.

preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.subtitle: Saved to your account and used above workspace defaults; query pages may temporarily override time display.

security.title: Security & sign-in
security.subtitle: Manage the sign-in and security capabilities of this account.
security.password_description: Receive a secure password reset link at your sign-in email.
security.reset_sent: If this email can receive mail, a password reset message has been sent.

mfa.title: Authenticator app
mfa.description_off: Signing in also asks for a 6-digit code from an authenticator app, such as Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or 1Password.
mfa.description_on: On since {{time}}. Signing in also asks for a code from your authenticator app.
mfa.setup_description: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app, or type the key in by hand, then enter the 6-digit code the app shows.
mfa.qr_alt: QR code for an authenticator app
mfa.confirm_factor: Confirm with a second factor this account already has.
mfa.confirm_password: Enter your account password to confirm.
mfa.disable_description: Signing in will only ask for your password, and the recovery codes stop working.
mfa.disable_description_keep: Signing in will no longer ask for a code from the app; your passkeys can verify it’s you. Recovery codes keep working.
mfa.passkey_hint: Press the button below and follow your browser’s prompt to confirm with a passkey.
mfa.sign_in_again: You signed in more than 10 minutes ago. Sign in again, then set this up.
mfa.required_by: “{{organizations}}” asks for multi-factor authentication, so the last second factor has to stay.
mfa.others_signed_out: Your other devices have been signed out.

recovery.title: Recovery codes
recovery.description_one: If you lose your authenticator or passkeys, each recovery code signs you in once. {{count}} code left.
recovery.description_other: If you lose your authenticator or passkeys, each recovery code signs you in once. {{count}} codes left.
recovery.regenerate_description: All your current recovery codes stop working.
recovery.save_description: If you lose your authenticator or passkeys, each recovery code signs you in once. They are shown only this once, so keep them somewhere safe.
recovery.file_note: Each code signs you in once in place of a second factor.

passkeys.title: Passkeys
passkeys.description: Verify it’s you with a fingerprint, your face or your device’s passcode: no codes to type, and safe from phishing sites. They can be kept in iCloud Keychain, Google Password Manager, 1Password or a security key.
passkeys.add_description: Press Create and follow your browser’s prompt. Afterwards it can sign you in on its own, or verify it’s you after your password.
passkeys.name: Name (optional)
passkeys.already_added: This device or password manager already has a passkey for this account
passkeys.wrong_address: This address isn’t the instance’s external URL, so passkeys don’t work here
passkeys.rename_description: The name only tells your passkeys apart here. Left empty, it shows where the passkey is kept.
passkeys.remove_description: It can’t sign you in any more. A copy kept in iCloud Keychain or a password manager has to be deleted there.
passkeys.remove_description_last: This is the account’s last second factor: deleting it turns multi-factor authentication off, and the recovery codes stop working.

unavailable.not_configured: This instance has no external URL (http.external_url), so passkeys aren’t available yet.
unavailable.ip_address: This instance’s external URL is an IP address; passkeys need a domain name.
unavailable.not_https: This instance’s external URL isn’t HTTPS; passkeys need HTTPS.

org_entry.mfa_description: This workspace asks for multi-factor authentication. Once verified, this sign-in won’t ask again.
org_entry.setup_description: Turn on an authenticator app or a passkey under Security & sign-in, then enter this workspace.
org_entry.sso_description: Sign in through a provider below to enter this workspace.

linked.title: Linked sign-in methods
linked.description: These single sign-on identities sign in to this account directly.
linked.only_way: This is the only way to sign in to this account. Set a password before unlinking it.
linked.unlink_description: {{provider}} ({{organization}}) will no longer sign you in to this account directly. Signing in with it again asks you to confirm with your password or an email code.

sessions.title: Active sessions
sessions.subtitle: View and manage the sign-in state on this device.
sessions.signed_out_others: Your other devices have been signed out
sessions.sign_out_others_failed: Couldn’t sign out the other devices
sessions.others_description: Every sign-in in another browser or on another computer ends; this browser stays signed in.

api_tokens.title: API tokens
api_tokens.subtitle: Tokens that call the API as you. A token never does more than you may at the time; when your access shrinks or you leave the organization, so does the token.
api_tokens.empty_description: Create a token for a script, collector, or integration, narrowed to what it needs.

workspace.title: Workspace & identity
workspace.subtitle: View your workspaces, roles, and advanced identifiers used by automation.
workspace.current_disabled: You are already using this workspace.
workspace.organization_disabled: This organization is disabled by a platform administrator.
workspace.switching_disabled: A workspace switch is already in progress.
workspace.org_slug_hint: Used in APIs, resource paths, and automation references.
